protocol.inputs: Market probability plus 10 spot and four flow features; no labels as inputs
protocol.adaptation: Frozen pretrained weights; fit supplies training context, not gradient fine-tuning
protocol.blend: Convex probability blend weight fitted by inner log loss on earlier training dates; set to zero if inner Brier is worse than market
protocol.split: Existing chronological outer folds and embargoed inner training split; no outer selection
protocol.limits: Reused development dates; no fine-tuning, holdout access, remote inference or automatic promotion
